title: INTRODUCTION TO THERMODYNAMICS
description: Introduces basic concepts of thermodynamics, by applying the first and second laws of thermodynamics. Solves engineering problems involving closed and open systems, as well as basic power and refrigeration cycles. CROSSLISTED as ME 310/NSE 310.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (MTH 256 or 256H) and (ENGR 212, 212H, ME 217 or NSE 235).
A minimum grade of C is required in MTH 256, MTH 256H, ENGR 212, ENGR 212H, ME 217 and NSE 235.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
meeting_html: TR 10am-11:50am in LINC 128 - Learning Innovation Center 128 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
